definitions.explanation: The bustling, commercial part of a city or town where shops, restaurants, and people gather. Focuses on the streetscape and atmosphere rather than the administrative unit.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{街|まち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the holiday, I went shopping downtown.

examples.japanese: ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{街|まち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦イルミネーション→イルミネーション：29122_irumineeshon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The town was beautifully lit up with Christmas illuminations.

notes:
USAGE:
{街|まち} emphasizes the physical streetscape, commercial areas, and atmosphere of a place. It evokes images of busy streets lined with shops, restaurants, and people. Use {街|まち} when describing going out to the lively parts of a city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街|まち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go out to town)
- {街|まち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk around town)
- {街並|まちな}み (townscape, rows of buildings along a street)
- ⟦{街角|まちかど}→街角：15540_machikado⟧ (street corner)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: town, municipality — refers to the administrative unit or a residential neighborhood, while {街|まち} focuses on commercial streets and urban atmosphere
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧: city — a formal term for a large urban area
